rationale: The Court is likely to reverse on a narrow, administrable pleading rule: § 271(b) requires plausible allegations of defendant-authored, purposefully directed encouragement of the patented use, not merely lawful skinny-label compliance plus foreseeable market dynamics. A Sotomayor dissent is the most likely separate writing, arguing the complaint’s “constellation of facts” plausibly supports an inference of specific intent warranting discovery.
